不属于当前Client projection的commit不生成空changes、不占用单inflight ACK通道

客户端整批copy-on-write原子应用；messageSeq保证传输连续，commitSeq允许跨过不可见提交但拒绝回退；unknown type/apply failure/乱序均作废整批并请求snapshot，hostBoot/session变化同时丢弃旧增量状态

snapshot-only structural link after initial feed connection
unknown change type after a valid first change
messageSeq gap, commitSeq regression and hostBootId change
